subject: Request for one-off rebate: prefetch feature slip — exec signoff requested
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@sprouthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-off rebate for prefetch delay (SproutHealth)

Laura / Marcus — looping you both in because this is now a commercial ask that needs quick guidance and likely exec signoff.

Summary: SproutHealth has flagged a 30% increase in inference token consumption since they started using the current routing behavior (no prefetch). Their Q2 usage overshot projections and procurement is asking for a commercial mitigation while prefetch is shipped. They are asking for a one-off rebate to offset the excess costs through the feature delivery window.

Key facts from the customer (see attached sprout_negotiation_summary.xlsx):
- Account: SproutHealth (enterprise, healthcare analytics)
- Current monthly bill: ~$120k (hosted tokens + embeddings)
- Estimated incremental cost due to prefetch absence: ~$15k/month (May–Jul) => ~ $45k aggregate
- Business impact: delayed timeline for their pilot to expand to 3 regions if cost issue unresolved

Asks:
1) Product: confirm ship window for prefetch and any temporary config we can enable to reduce token usage.
2) Finance/Rev Ops: recommend structure (credit vs. rate adjustment) and the amount we can approve at the manager level vs. needing VP/exec signoff.
3) Sales/CS: preferred language for TOS and whether customer will accept credits (not cash).

Customer note (Tom is on Cc) — they want a clear pledge by EOD that we will provide a remediation path.

Proposed internal option I think will land: up to $35k one-off credit (applied to invoices) + 10% discounted compute for 1 quarter, contingent on prefetch GA within 8 weeks. That keeps runway limited and aligns incentives. Asking Marcus/Neha for approval or guidance.

Attachments: sprout_negotiation_summary.xlsx (cost calc), I will add the prefetch roadmap once I have the dates.

Thanks —
Logan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@sprouthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-off rebate for prefetch delay (SproutHealth)

Logan — thanks for the heads up and for the cost workbook. 

Quick product context and timeline:
- Prefetch (KV-prefix caching for multi-request patterns) was prioritized but we hit a perf regression in the latest kernel build that requires another 2 engineering sprints to stabilize instrumentation and QA. Current realistic GA window is 6 weeks (we can do a limited opt-in alpha in ~4 weeks).
- Short-term mitigations we can enable today: route SproutHealth to a higher burst pool (dedicated routing) which reduces effective token duplication by ~12% but has capacity/cost implications on our side.

My recommendation: offer the customer a combined approach — enable routing to the burst/dedicated pool immediately (technical mitigation) and provide a conditional credit if GA slips beyond the 6-week window. The credit should be capped and tied to clear milestones (alpha availability, GA date).

Im attaching prefetch_roadmap_v2.pdf with the milestones. If we commit to the alpha in 4 weeks and GA within 6, I can sign off on the routing change now. If GA slips beyond 8 weeks we should have a commercial remedy in place.

Laura Bennett
Head of Product, Serving Runtime

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@sprouthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-off rebate for prefetch delay (SproutHealth) — proposed commercial structure

Thanks Logan / Laura. I pulled the numbers and sketched two commercial options for approval:

Option A (credit-first, limited):
- One-off invoice credit of $30,000 (applied across next two invoices)
- 1 quarter 10% compute discount starting month after credit applied
- Conditional on prefetch alpha within 4 weeks and GA within 6 weeks; if GA misses 8 weeks we convert to an additional $10k credit (cap $40k)
- Legal to sign short TOS amendment (credit-only, non-refundable, not transferable)

Option B (rate-adjustment):
- Temporary 15% rate adjustment for 2 months (automated billing rule) capped at $25k exposure to us
- No credit line item; simpler to apply but less visible to customer finance teams

Impact / ask: Option A better preserves long-term ARR math and is more visible to procurement. Approval threshold: I can approve up to $20k at manager level. Anything > $20k needs Neha or exec signoff. Option A at $30k therefore needs Neha.

Attachments: draft_rebate_tos.docx (language we should send to customer)

Neha — can you review and approve Option A (proposed ask $30k with contingency to $40k if GA misses 8 weeks)? If you prefer Option B, Ill implement billing rule and notify procurement.

Marcus
Revenue Operations

Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-off rebate for prefetch delay (SproutHealth) — APPROVED (conditional)

Team — after reviewing the trade-offs I approve Option A with a firm cap and conditions. Please proceed with the following: 

Approved commercial remedy (conditions):
- One-off credit of $32,500 applied across the next two invoices (credit-only, non-refundable).
- 10% compute discount for the first full month after the credit is exhausted (not stackable with other discounts).
- Credit is contingent on: (1) Prefetch alpha available to SproutHealth within 4 weeks; (2) GA within 6 weeks. If GA misses 8 weeks the credit increases by an additional $7,500, up to a strict cap of $40,000.
- Customer must sign the TOS amendment prior to credit issuance. Use draft_rebate_tos.docx — legal to review within 24 hours.

Logan / Marcus — action items:
- Marcus: update HubSpot deal RWD-4932 with the approved credit and schedule a billing rule; attach signed TOS when completed: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4932
- Marcus: prepare the invoice credit schedule and notify billing ops.
- Logan: inform Tom and procurement that we've approved the credit in principle and will send the TOS for signature. Confirm they accept credits (not cash) and that the timeline commitment is acceptable.
- Laura: escalate immediately if alpha slips from the 4-week target. If we miss the 6-week GA you must notify Marcus and Neha so the contingency can be applied.

Neha Kapoor
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
